method: Gaussian nearest-neighbor MRF; exact discrete joint MAP by dynamic programming
interval_note: Pointwise model-conditional marginal intervals; not calibrated experimental errors.

intensity_comparison.curvature: Positive part of negative 2D curvature; Cx=Cy=1
intensity_comparison.gradient: Smoothed intensity / RMS of eight neighbor directional differences
intensity_comparison.coordinates: Input axes divided by their median spacing (pixel-equivalent units)
intensity_comparison.normalization: Each map globally peak-normalized to [0, 1]; featureless columns set to zero
intensity_comparison.band_extraction: Column-wise global maximum of each enhanced map; no continuity prior
